diagnosis: Check C1 passed in all rollouts despite missing PF3, indicating a default or heuristic that allows a low cash collateral requirement. Specifically, the model defaulted to a lower cash collateral amount (e.g., 7,000,000 USD) instead of the higher 4,000,000 USD required by PF3, allowing C1 to pass.

C1.why: Without PF3, the desk has no confirmed collateral source supporting the increase, so a cautious decision would fail to approve it conditionally, require exactly 4000000 of cash collateral, and include the pre-activation collateral commitment.
